name: peek
description: Experimental. /peek <path>[:line] shows a file from this repo, its worktrees or a folder you approve, in a pane: Markdown, code, tables, JSON, images, PDF, Word and audio. /peek alone filters the repo's files, /peek diff shows what changed, and /peek allow approves a folder. It refuses the files the kit's secrets guard protects, except a .env file, which opens in an editor with its values masked. Needs Claude Code 2.1.288 or newer.
